in_sanskrit.name: अशिष
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: अश (as) - not, शिष (shisha) - desire or thirst; hence, one who is free from all desires and content.

in_hindi.name: अशिष
in_hindi.long_meaning: अश (ash) - not, इष (isha) - desire; hence, one who is free from all desires and content.
